_notes: Locally added -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Family Guy.
Built from a 4-player game driven through the cabinet's own streamer.
current_player and current_ball are adjacent in CPU RAM at 0x00033AEC and 0x00033AED, player low
Scores are 4 bytes on 8-byte centres from 0x021109E4, the only group the sweep offered.
Five records from 0x02102B60 in the usual 32-byte form, bounded by where the checksum stops
validating. No mode champions: the block ends at five and the post-game DMD cycle showed the
high score ladder only.
Only fg_1200af is claimed; SAM addresses move between revisions.
game_over and credits come from a 1,101-frame recording of live memory spanning an operator-menu
session and a full game. The session also promoted ball_count and max_credits from derived to
measured: menu values 5 and 9 landed at adjustment indices 30 and 32 as the free_play-relative
rule predicted.
game_over at 0x00032E04 reads 5 in attract and 0 in play, dropping at the exact frame the game
started -- the same frame credits fell -- and returning 24 samples after the last score, the
bonus and match sequence. Correct in all 1,101 frames. Any non-zero value is game over, so no
mask is needed. This game does NOT keep the ball+0x31 status byte its siblings use; that byte is
a constant 3 here.
credits at 0x0211100C, the tenth SAM game at that address: rose 1,2,3 with the coins, fell to 2
at game start.
tilted is deliberately absent, and this is a measured conclusion rather than a gap. Three
recordings were made, one with a mid-ball tilt on ball 1 that froze scoring at 770 from f31 to
the drain. The tap was widened until every CPU region had been covered: 0x00000-0x2FFFF,
0x40000-0x7FFFF and 0x80000-0xFFFFF did not change by a single byte across a full game, so
this ROM's entire live RAM is the 64KB block at 0x30000-0x3FFFF, and no byte in it holds one
value through the tilt and a shared other value through normal play -- nor does any 'ball live'
style flag drop at the tilt. The only trace of the tilt is a display event code at 0x00037720
(8 resting, 68 at ball start, 64 at the warning, 20 for the duration of the tilt); it shares
bits with the other events, so no mask isolates it and it is not declared.
